units.source_text: 薰中纳言回想：“大女公子过去对于诗歌赠答等细事，也很谨慎小心，总是温和诚恳地待人。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought back: Even in small matters such as exchanging poems, the elder lady had always been careful and discreet, treating people with gentle sincerity.

units.source_text: 此次倘真个永别了，教我何以为心！”

en.t: If this should truly become an eternal parting, how am I to bear it?

units.source_text: 便忧惧万状。

en.t: He was filled with every kind of anxiety and dread.

units.source_text: 他忆起了阿阇梨梦见八亲王之事，推想八亲王在天之灵也挂念着两女公子的苦况，

en.t: He remembered how the Ajari had dreamed of the Eighth Prince, and supposed that the prince's spirit in heaven must also be worrying over the sufferings of his two daughters,

units.source_text: 便在八亲王生前曾住的山寺里也请僧众诵经念佛。

en.t: so he also asked the monks at the mountain temple where the Eighth Prince had lived to chant sutras and invoke the Buddha.

units.source_text: 又遣使者往各处寺庙，为大女公子举办祈祷。

en.t: He sent messengers to temples in many places as well, arranging prayers for the elder lady.

units.source_text: 京中公务私事一概请假。

en.t: He took leave from all his public and private duties in the capital.

units.source_text: 祭告神祇，祓除邪恶，凡百法事，无不做到。

en.t: He made offerings and prayers to the deities, performed rites to drive away evil, and left no Buddhist service undone.

units.source_text: 然而这病不是由于鬼怪作祟，故法事全无效验。

en.t: Yet her illness was not caused by a malign spirit, and so the rites had no effect at all.

units.source_text: 如果病人自己盼望痊愈而向佛祈愿，则或可见效。

en.t: If the patient herself had wished to recover and prayed to the Buddha, there might perhaps have been some result.

units.source_text: 但大女公子不然，她想：“我还不如乘此机会，早日死去。

en.t: But the elder lady did not feel that way. She thought, I would rather take this chance and die soon.

units.source_text: 中纳言如此接近我，全然不避嫌疑，今已无法拒远他了。

en.t: The Middle Counselor has come so close to me and has not avoided suspicion at all; now I can no longer reject him or keep him at a distance.

units.source_text: 如果就此和他结了缘，深恐这种亲切之情日后逐渐消减，

en.t: If I form a bond with him now, I deeply fear that this tenderness may gradually fade in days to come,

units.source_text: 弄得双方互相疏远，倒是很可忧虑之事。

en.t: and if we should end up growing distant from one another, that would be a truly troubling thing.

units.source_text: 故我此次如果不死，定当以疾病为借口，削发为尼。

en.t: So if I do not die this time, I will certainly use my illness as a pretext, cut off my hair, and become a nun.

units.source_text: 只有如此，才是保证双方爱情长久的办法。”

en.t: Only in this way can I make sure that our love endures.

units.source_text: 她打定主意，不管如此如彼，务须照此实行。

en.t: She made up her mind that, whatever happened, she must carry this out.

units.source_text: 但也不便骄矜地向薰中纳言说出，便对二女公子说道：

en.t: But she could not very well speak of it proudly to Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, so she said to the younger lady:

units.source_text: “我近来愈觉此身已无生望。

en.t: Lately I feel more and more that this body has no hope of living.

units.source_text: 听说授戒为尼，功德甚大，可以却病延年。

en.t: I hear that receiving the vows and becoming a nun brings great merit, and can drive away illness and prolong life.

units.source_text: 你去请阿阇梨替我授戒吧。”

en.t: Please go and ask the Ajari to give me the vows.

units.source_text: 众侍女听了这话，大家喧噪哭泣起来，说道：

en.t: When the waiting women heard this, they all began crying out and weeping, saying:

units.source_text: “万无此理！

en.t: That must never be done!

units.source_text: 中纳言大人如此操心担忧，叫他多么失望啊！”

en.t: Lord Middle Counselor has taken such pains and worried so much; how bitterly disappointed he would be!

units.source_text: 她们都认为此事不该，没有人向薰中纳言传达。

en.t: They all thought this should not be done, and no one conveyed it to Kaoru, the Middle Counselor.

units.source_text: 大女公子不胜怅惘。

en.t: The elder lady was overcome with sorrowful frustration.
